run_merge_shards_module: run the MergeShardsModule to merge sorted bitext shards into a single sorted output file
create_merge_shards_config: create a MergeShardsConfig dataclass with source language, target language, output directory, and shard file pairs
use_shard_for_merge_context: use ShardForMerge as a context manager to open and manage text and metadata shard files
read_next_line_with_dedup: call try_read_next_line on a ShardForMerge to read the next unique line while deduplicating via xxhash
copy_line_to_output: call copy_line on a ShardForMerge to write the current line to output text and metadata files
